comments.author: @UnlivableEarth
comments.text: Herbie Nayokpuk running the Iditarod 11 times, top 10 in eight of them, and finishing again 5 months after open-heart surgery… the "Shishmaref Cannonball" part alone was worth the watch. Never knew the village's water basically comes from snow fences catching drifts either. Life on a remote Alaskan island with no road out is something else.

comments.author: @WorldsOffTheMap
comments.text: Imagine living on an island where the frozen sea becomes your winter road, and every meal, every drop of water, and every journey requires patience and resilience. The traditions and connection to nature in this community are truly remarkable and fascinating. Hats off !
